description: Check a sign-up started with start_signup: pending | ready | claimed | needs_code | expired | failed. On "ready" the new API key is saved (~/.vivideo/config.json) and every Vivideo tool uses it right away — the key is never shown; if a key is already configured it is NOT replaced (key_issued_not_saved: the user runs `vivideo login`). "needs_code": the email had an account by payment time, the plan went to it; sign in with request_login_code. Pass wait_seconds (max 300) to wait for payment; polls at most every 10 s, so do not call it in a tight loop.

claim_token.description: Only if this server did not start the sign-up. Treat as a secret.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for payment (default 0: check once).

name: get_signup_status
